checks.name: Every simulated soldier has a unique stable ID and history
Each soldier belongs to exactly one squad
Cannot command the opposing team
Cannot issue order into deep river
Valid ground objective is accepted
Duplicate command returns its original receipt
Two independent squads advance without micro-management
Cancel stops order at the current position
Changing an order invalidates pending old paths
Unreachable opposite bank produces a blocked report, not teleportation

checks.name: Unknown enemy is absent from fog snapshot
Sight records an enemy position and observation tick
Hidden enemy retains old observed position, not current position
Cannot issue attack using an unobserved enemy ID
Each archer fires one finite shot and simultaneous damage is resolved
Out-of-ammo soldiers do not create repeated hits
Nearby medic stabilizes casualty once and consumes medical supply
Wounded identity and injury persist without double-counting during rescue
Medic moves towards a nearby casualty before stabilizing them
Untreated casualty becomes dead once and is never removed
Loss threshold uses initial deployed denominator and triggers retreat
Supply is debited exactly once at departure
Supply movement does not mutate the simulation configuration
Physical convoy delivers its reserved cargo exactly once
Enemy near route stops convoy without duplicating or delivering cargo
Insufficient capacity does not create cargo or debit stock
Nearby supply transfers finite ammunition from depot
Repair reserves finite timber
Repair completes once and restores depot health
Recruitment is possible only with missing active soldier and available stock
Recruit has a new ID and cannot resurrect the old soldier
Interrupted work refunds the reserved timber once
A real character melee action can damage an army soldier exactly once
An army archer can damage the controlled character without duplicate shots
Character guard uses the real army archer position
Player can select and shoot a real army soldier once
Same scenario and commands produce the same snapshot
